source_title: Current crisis could help PM Tusk in 2027 polls, but it may also backfire both against him and President Nawrocki: Polish expert Krzysztof Marcin Zalewski
source_excerpt:

Dramatic visuals emerged over night from Warsaw as President Karol Nawrocki ordered his Senegal-bound aircraft to turn midway in Spanish airspace as a political crisis erupted between him and the Government of Prime Minister Donald Tusk over the top posts in the Constitutional Tribunal, one of the most important organs of post-Cold War Poland . Krzysztof Marcin Zalewski, Chairperson of Boym Institute, a leading think tank in Warsaw spoke over phone about the trajectory of the crisis and the way ahead for the Donald Tusk government.
